description_ru: Два друга выбирают, как провести выходные: в горах или у моря. Сравнения и разговор о будущем.
text:
Tom: What are you going to do this weekend, Wendy?
Wendy: I am not sure. The weather forecast says it will be sunny on Saturday.
Tom: Great! Why don't we go to the mountains?
Wendy: The mountains are beautiful, but the road is very long. The sea is closer.
Tom: That is true. But the beach is more crowded than the mountains.
Wendy: Hmm. Last summer, we went to the beach, and it was terrible. There were too many people.
Tom: OK, let's go to the mountains. I will bring sandwiches and fruit.
Wendy: And I will bring a map and warm jackets. It is colder in the mountains.
Tom: What time shall we leave?
Wendy: Let's leave at seven. Then we can have lunch at the top.
Tom: Seven o'clock on Saturday? That is early!
Wendy: Do not worry. I will bring you a strong coffee.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро раскройте; зубы не касаются губы, не «в».
Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены; не раскатистое русское «р».

questions.question: What will the weather be on Saturday?
Where do they decide to go?
What time are they going to leave?
